_comment: Design 7.1.2: the ink ladder's station. Rime is the chill, since a tough thing frozen shatters rather
than smears; the astrite block is the flywheel, the same inertia the seismograph hangs it for; the blaze
rod is the drive shaft, the diamonds the abrasive edge and the blackstone the heavy housing. The Nether
parts are the midgame vanilla a fine-rung machine asks for. Arc crystal is not here because the grinder
needs a block of it beside it, and a grindstone.
